map.输入出生日期，计算达到完全民事行为能力（18岁）、刑事责任年龄、结婚年龄等各项法: Enter a date of birth and compute the date from which each legal right and obligation begins - full civil capacity (18), age of criminal responsibility, marriageable age - and whether the person now qualifies.
map.核对某人是否已达成年（18 周岁）、婚龄（男 22/女 20）、刑事责任年龄等关: Check whether someone has reached adulthood (18 full years), marriageable age (22 for men, 20 for women), the age of criminal responsibility and other key milestones.
map.计算到某一法律里程碑（如退休、完全行为能力）的剩余天数。: Compute the days remaining to a legal milestone (such as retirement or full civil capacity).
map.判断劳动者是否达到特定用工年龄限制。: Judge whether a worker has reached a specific employment age limit.
map.：出生 2008-05-01，2026-05-01 满 18 周岁（完全民事行为: : born 2008-05-01, turns 18 on 2026-05-01 (full civil capacity); a male born 2004-01-01 reaches the legal marriage age of 22 in 2026.
map.：已满 14 周岁不满 16 周岁对八类严重犯罪负刑责；已满 16 周岁对所有犯: : from age 14 to under 16, criminal responsibility attaches for eight serious categories of crime; at 16 and above it attaches for all crimes; the tool flags the corresponding milestones by date of birth.
map.年龄按虚岁还是周岁？: Is age counted in nominal or actual years?
map.法律上的年龄一律按公历周岁计算，自生日次日起满一岁。: Legal age is always counted in full years on the Gregorian calendar, turning a year older from the day after the birthday.
map.16 岁能算完全行为能力吗？: Can a 16-year-old count as having full capacity?
map.十六周岁以上的未成年人，以自己的劳动收入为主要生活来源的，视为完全民事行为能力人: A minor aged 16 or above whose own labour income is the main source of livelihood is regarded as a person with full civil capacity.
